results.rationale: The carton keeps its blue-and-cream design, cap and cow illustration. The cow side becomes somewhat wider, but the front MILK panel and cap top remain prominent; the reference instead shows a straight cow-panel side elevation. The rotation is substantially incomplete, while the final carton is cleanly rendered with coherent edges and graphics.

Blue upholstery, wooden legs and the white background persist, but the chaise extension disappears and the three-seat form becomes a two-seat loveseat. The view turns toward the front yet remains oblique and does not reproduce the reference's full three-seat chaise arrangement. Mottled, smeared texture on the right arm and cushion edge is a noticeable quality defect.
